# TERRA STUDIO
> Handcrafted Scandinavian stoneware ceramics, sculptural minimalist vases, organic linen textiles, and warm ambient lighting.

TERRA STUDIO is a modern Nordic design studio and ceramic workshop crafting timeless tableware, vessels, and living objects rooted in Danish minimalism and tactile Japanese wabi-sabi philosophy.

## Collections
- [Stoneware Dining](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/stoneware-dining): Twice-fired artisanal ceramic plates, bowls, and mugs celebrating organic speckled clay bodies.
- [Sculptural Vases](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/sculptural-vases): Architectural vessels, unglazed fluted terra cotta, and brutalist ceramic pedestals.
- [Ambient Lighting](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/ambient-lighting): Solid brushed brass table lamps and mouth-blown frosted opal glass shades casting soothing 2700K warmth.
- [Living Textiles](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/living-textiles): OEKO-TEX certified European flax linen throws and tactile bouclé cushions.
- [Curated Objects](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/curated-objects): Carved Roman travertine trays, stoneware candle holders, and organic incense burners.
- [Complete Catalog](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/all): All handcrafted studio pieces and limited workshop releases.

## Core Products
- [Speckled Ceramic Dinner Plate Set](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/products/speckled-ceramic-dinner-plate-set): Four-piece stoneware dining set twice-fired at 1,280°C with subtle iron flecks ($145.00).
- [Fluted Matte Terra Cotta Vase](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/products/fluted-matte-terra-cotta-vase): Unglazed sculptural vessel featuring rhythmic vertical ridges ($115.00).
- [Brushed Brass Accent Lamp](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/products/brushed-brass-accent-lamp): Solid machined brass base with mouth-blown frosted opal diffuser ($210.00).
- [Woven Organic Linen Throw](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/products/woven-organic-linen-throw): Pre-washed 100% European flax with handcrafted eyelash fringes ($160.00).
- [Ribbed Stoneware Candle Holder](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/products/ribbed-stoneware-candle-holder): Heavy mineral-clay base designed for standard taper candles ($65.00).
- [Carved Travertine Catchall Tray](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/products/carved-travertine-catchall-tray): Monolithic natural beige travertine stone with honed matte texture ($130.00).
